title: panopsis sessilifolia
intro: Panopsis sessilifolia, commonly known as the Rocky Mountain or Western Panopsis, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family Ericaceae. It is a shrub that is native to the mountainous regions of western North America. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of Panopsis sessilifolia include triterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer properties.
